basic_details.short_information: The PM SHRI School Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya (JNV) has officially announced the PGT Chemistry Recruitment 2026 with 1 opening. The detailed notification has been published on the official website. Candidates who are not more than 50 years of age and possess a Master's Degree in Chemistry with at least 50% marks, a B.Ed. from an NCTE-recognized institution, and proficiency in teaching both Hindi and English can submit their online applications up to 05-08-2026. The walk-in interview is scheduled for 06-08-2026. Direct links to download the notification and apply online are shared below.

qualification.education_qualification: Master Degree in Chemistry with 50% marks and B.Ed. from NCTE recognized institute, Proficiency in teaching Hindi and English
qualification.details: PGT Chemistry: Integrated Post Graduate Course from NCTE recognized institution in Chemistry or any specialization in Chemistry with at least 50% marks including B.Ed. component OR Master Degree from recognized institution with at least 50% marks in Chemistry or specialization AND B.Ed. Degree from NCTE recognized institute with at least 50% marks OR Three years integrated B.Ed./M.Ed. from NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks OR Four years Integrated degree with at least 50% marks from NCTE recognized institution including B.Ed. component. Proficiency in teaching in Hindi and English Medium.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of PM SHRI JNV Panikoili to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGT Chemistry post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the PGT Chemistry post is 05-08-2026.

faq.answer: Candidates must have a Master's Degree in Chemistry with 50% marks and a B.Ed. from an NCTE recognized institute. Proficiency in teaching Hindi and English is also required.

faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the PGT Chemistry post is 50 years.
